sentences.en: Our village is Catholic, but the neighbouring village is Evangelist.
sentences.zh: 我们的村庄是天主教的，但相邻的村庄是福音派的。

sentences.en: The border between the two neighbouring countries remains closed.
The two neighbouring countries differ from each other in all respects.
sentences.zh: 这两个相邻国家在各个方面都不同。
